---
title: "Global panzoom"
format:
  html:
    code-tools: true
filters:
  - path: ../../_filters/show-source.lua
    at: pre-ast
  - panzoom
panzoom:
  match: auto
  hint: false
lightbox:
  match: auto
  effect: fade
  desc-position: right
  loop: true
---

## About

panzoom takes every image lightbox would take on its own, so no image needs to
be marked. lightbox is set up too, but only cells that ask for it with the
`#| lightbox: true` cell option, or with lightbox options such as `group`, open
in it. The same cases open in lightbox alone on the [lightbox
page](a-lightbox.html). The hint line is off.

```yaml
filters:
  - panzoom
panzoom:
  match: auto
  hint: false
lightbox:
  match: auto
  effect: fade
  desc-position: right
  loop: true
```

## 1. Single image {#c1 expect-open="panzoom"}

A markdown image with a description. It opens in panzoom, with the description
below the caption. panzoom has no `desc-position`, so the image's
`desc-position="left"` has no effect.

```markdown {.show-source}
![A markdown image with a description and `desc-position="left"`. It opens in panzoom, with the description below the caption, since panzoom has no `desc-position`.](../../images/mv-0.jpg){description="Chilmark has _some_ of the best beaches. **credit:** [Chilmark Beach](https://unsplash.com/photos/VBDJGOMCwps)" desc-position="left" fig-alt="Sunset over a sandy beach, with a tall rock stack against the sun"}
```

## 2. Gallery in a layout {#c2 expect-open="panzoom"}

Three images in a layout, joined by `group="elsewhere"`. Each opens in panzoom,
in one three-image gallery.

```markdown {.show-source}
::: {layout="[[1, 1], [1]]"}
![Aquinnah, one of three images joined by `group`. They open in panzoom as a three-image gallery.](../../images/mv-1.jpg){group="elsewhere" description="The waves break off Aquinnah." fig-alt="Waves breaking below grassy clay cliffs at Aquinnah"}

![Oak Bluffs, in the same gallery.](../../images/mv-3.jpg){group="elsewhere" description="Gingerbread cottages." fig-alt="A shingled gingerbread cottage with pink and green trim, behind a garden path"}

![Vineyard lighthouse, in the same gallery.](../../images/mv-2.jpg){group="elsewhere" description="Edgartown Lighthouse." fig-alt="A white lighthouse against a blue sky"}
:::
```

## 3. Math {#c3 expect-open="panzoom"}

A markdown image with math in its caption and description. It opens in panzoom,
with both typeset.

```markdown {.show-source}
![Caption with math $e^{i\pi}+1=0$](../../images/mv-4.jpg){description="Description with math $\\int_0^1 x^2\\,dx = 1/3$" fig-alt="A sailboat with a flag-striped sail off a sandy beach"}
```

## 4. Markdown subfigures {#c4 expect-open="panzoom"}

A figure with two markdown subfigures. Either one opens in panzoom, in a
two-image gallery. The figure's caption links to the heat map in [case
12](#c12).

```markdown {.show-source}
::: {#fig-md-sub layout-ncol=2}
![Sub A](../../images/mv-1.jpg){#fig-md-a fig-alt="Waves breaking below grassy clay cliffs at Aquinnah"}

![Sub B](../../images/mv-2.jpg){#fig-md-b fig-alt="A white lighthouse against a blue sky"}

Two markdown subfigures, with a link to the heat map at the end of the page (see @fig-plain). They open in panzoom as a two-image gallery.
:::
```

## 5. R subfigures {#c5 expect-open="panzoom"}

One R cell with two plots, made subfigures by `fig-subcap`. Either one opens in
panzoom, in a two-image gallery.

```{r}
#| label: fig-r-sub
#| fig-cap: >-
#|   Two subfigures from one R cell. They open in panzoom as a two-image
#|   gallery.
#| fig-subcap: ["Pressure", "Cars"]
#| fig-alt:
#|   - "Scatter plot of vapor pressure rising steeply with temperature"
#|   - "Scatter plot of stopping distance against speed for 50 cars"
#| layout-ncol: 2

plot(pressure)
plot(cars)
```

## 6. Cell options {#c6 expect-open="glightbox"}

Two R cells, joined by `group: r-graph` under the `lightbox` cell option. Asking
for lightbox keeps them out of panzoom, so either plot opens in lightbox, in a
two-image gallery, with its own description on the right.

```{r}
#| fig-alt: "Scatter plot of ten random points"
#| fig-cap: >-
#|   An R cell with lightbox options for a group and a description. Asking for
#|   lightbox keeps it out of panzoom, so it opens in lightbox, in a two-image
#|   gallery with the next plot.
#| lightbox:
#|   group: r-graph
#|   description: Ten random points.

plot(1:10, rnorm(10))
```

```{r}
#| fig-alt: "Scatter plot of stopping distance against speed for 50 cars"
#| fig-cap: >-
#|   The second R cell in the same group. It opens in lightbox, in the same
#|   gallery.
#| lightbox:
#|   group: r-graph
#|   description: Stopping distance against speed.

plot(cars)
```

## 7. Two plots in one cell {#c7 expect-open="glightbox"}

One R cell with two plots, each with its own caption and description, joined by
`group: cars` under the `lightbox` cell option. Either one opens in lightbox, in
a two-image gallery.

```{r}
#| fig-alt:
#|   - "Scatterplot matrix of the mtcars data, each variable plotted against every other"
#|   - "Scatter plot of stopping distance against speed for 50 cars"
#| fig-cap:
#|   - >-
#|     One R cell with two plots and lightbox options. They open in lightbox as
#|     a two-image gallery.
#|   - "The second plot of the cell, in the same gallery."
#| lightbox:
#|   group: cars
#|   description:
#|     - The mtcars data, each variable against every other.
#|     - Stopping distance against speed.

plot(mtcars)
plot(cars)
```

## 8. Opt out {#c8 expect-open="nothing"}

An R cell with `lightbox: false`. Neither lightbox nor panzoom takes it, so
clicking it does nothing.

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "An R cell with `lightbox: false`. Clicking it does nothing."
#| lightbox: false
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Scatterplot matrix of the mtcars data, each variable plotted against every
#|   other

plot(mtcars)
```

## 9. Image in a link {#c9 expect-open="navigation"}

An image inside a link. panzoom leaves linked images alone and keeps lightbox
from dropping the link, so clicking the image follows the link.

```markdown {.show-source}
[![A sailboat off Edgartown, linked to quarto.org.](../../images/mv-4.jpg){width=30% fig-alt="A sailboat with a flag-striped sail off a sandy beach, with an unrelated link to open the Quarto website"}](https://quarto.org)
```

## 10. Margin image {#c10 expect-open="panzoom"}

A markdown image in the margin. It opens in panzoom, as any other block image
does.

```markdown {.show-source}
![A gingerbread cottage in Oak Bluffs, placed in the page margin.](../../images/mv-3.jpg){.column-margin fig-alt="A shingled gingerbread cottage with pink and green trim, behind a garden path"}
```

## 11. Inline image {#c11 expect-open="nothing"}

An image inside a sentence. `match: auto` skips inline images, as lightbox does,
so clicking it does nothing.

```markdown {.show-source}
Some text with an inline image ![A white lighthouse](../../images/mv-2.jpg){width=60px} in the middle.
```

## 12. Plain R figure {#c12 expect-open="panzoom"}

A cross-referenced R figure with no options. It opens in panzoom. The caption of
[case 4](#c4) links to it.

```{r}
#| label: fig-plain
#| fig-alt: "Heat map of the Maunga Whau volcano's heights, in yellow, orange, and red"
#| fig-cap: "A cross-referenced R figure with no options. It opens in panzoom."

image(volcano)
```
